en: Close-up of a vintage postage stamp on a postcard. The stamp is maroon and cream, showing a shield with four striped panels surrounded by floral and ornamental motifs. At the top is the text "EESTI POST". At the bottom is the denomination "50+50" inside a decorative frame, and below that the word "CARITAS" with the numbers "19" and "39" on each side, indicating the year 1939. There is a light circular postmark over part of the design.
